blockingIssues.problem: The title asserts a prioritized action — that fixing rendering first will produce "the greatest immediate reduction in warnings" — but the source only reports counts of where parser warnings first appeared (four rendering, two ingestion) and explicitly says it "does not rank expected payoffs." The title therefore states a payoff ranking the source does not support.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: "Parser warnings first appeared in rendering in four runs and in ingestion in two... It does not rank expected payoffs." Also: "For the next selected failure, the review requires inspection of its actual preceding input and the earliest supported boundary before choosing an intervention."
blockingIssues.constraint: The source only provides occurrence counts and requires inspection of the specific preceding input and earliest supported boundary before choosing an intervention; it does not justify claiming that addressing rendering first yields the greatest immediate reduction in warnings.
